resumeText:
Arjun Nair | Bengaluru | arjun.nair@example.com

SUMMARY
Engineering leader with 15 years building SaaS and data products.

EXPERIENCE
Senior Engineering Manager, Tidewater Analytics, Bengaluru (2019 - present)
- Make architecture decisions across five teams in the data platform group.
- Review high level design for services handling two billion events a day.
- Line manager for four engineering managers and two staff engineers.
- Run interview loops and hired engineers and managers for a team growing from 30 to 70.
- Own the technology roadmap for the data platform area.
- Lead program management across teams and cross-team dependencies.
- Run sprint planning and quarterly planning with product.
- Set SLOs and error budgets for all platform services.
- Use stakeholder communication with product and sales leaders.

Engineering Manager, Pinecrest Software, Pune (2014 - 2019)
- Led the billing team.

Software Engineer, Konkan Infotech, Pune (2011 - 2014)

EDUCATION
BTech Computer Science, NIT Calicut, 2011
